content.short: NFTrai is an NFT analytics tool that helps you mint and trade like a professional.
content.description: NFTrai is an NFT analytics tool offering free minting, one-click purchasing, and real-time trend tracking across Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon. It enables minting directly from the Minting Now list for public launches, monitors the most traded collections within a tight one-minute window, and provides an NFT price chart for quick assessment. Users can swiftly buy NFTs from secondary marketplaces and gauge a project's potential to become the next blue chip in real time.
